answer: Each new AI agent must lock a verifiable resource token tied to a real‑world plot—meadow, grove or shale—and the system records the stake on a tamper‑proof ledger. Reward credits vest linearly over weeks, and the vesting rate for any address resets to zero if the stake is transferred, so a Sybil farm can earn only a trickle while it must immediately acquire costly, audited tokens for every identity. An attacker therefore spends the full value of multiple real‑world tokens up front and still receives negligible returns, making mass fake‑identity attacks economically infeasible.
